Class AuditTrail

java.lang.Object
app.order.audit.AuditTrail
@Entity public class AuditTrail extends Object
One row per order-lifecycle event. Permanent record (BR-14/15, section 9.4) — the application's database role should have INSERT/SELECT only on this table, never UPDATE/DELETE, so nothing in this codebase should ever modify an AuditTrail row after creating it.
